name: FauxmoESP
description: fauxmoESP 3.4.1 (Amazon Alexa as a Belkin WeMo / Hue bridge) for LibreTiny: the ESP32 code paths with WiFi.h / AsyncTCP.h, the MD5 functions of the LibreTiny core instead of MD5Builder, which LibreTiny does not have, and the SSDP listener on a lwIP udp_pcb instead of WiFiUDP (about 3.5 KiB less heap, closed while paused)
